tasks.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). This step is crucial for achieving the right temperature for baking the banana bread. Ensure the oven is preheated before proceeding with the recipe.
acceptance_criteria: Given the oven is preheated, when a thermometer is inserted, then it reads 350°F (175°C).

tasks.description: Grease a 9x5 loaf pan to prevent the banana bread from sticking to it. This step is essential for easy removal of the bread after baking.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loaf pan is greased, when the banana bread is baked and removed, then it does not stick to the pan.

tasks.description: Mash 3 ripe bananas with a fork until smooth. This step is necessary for achieving the right consistency for the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bananas are mashed, when they are stirred, then they are smooth and free of lumps.

tasks.description: Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas. This step combines the flavors and textures of the ingredients.
acceptance_criteria: Given the butter and bananas are mixed, when they are stirred, then they are well combined.

tasks.description: Mix in the baking soda and salt. These ingredients are essential for the texture and flavor of the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the baking soda and salt are added, when the mixture is stirred, then they are well combined.

tasks.description: Stir in the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract. These ingredients add sweetness, moisture, and flavor to the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sugar, egg, and vanilla are added, when the mixture is stirred, then they are well combined.

tasks.description: Fold in the flour until just combined. This step is crucial for achieving the right texture for the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flour is folded in, when the mixture is stirred, then it is just combined and not overmixed.

tasks.description: Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. This step is necessary for baking the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the batter is poured into the loaf pan, when the pan is lifted, then the batter is evenly distributed.

tasks.description: Bake the banana bread for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. This step is essential for achieving the right texture and flavor for the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the banana bread is baked, when a toothpick is inserted into the center, then it comes out clean.
